title: Selling Plans Account Operations Standard — Opening, Verification and Activation
content:
**Standard.** A **Selling Plans** plan opens in pending verification and goes live only when identity, tax and bank verification completes. A store plan requires a store name; the Individual Seller Plan has none. A plan whose minimum trailing 12-month sales is above zero may be opened only by a seller whose gross sales over the trailing 12 months meet it. A plan still in pending verification when its verification deadline (counted in calendar days from the date the plan was opened) has passed is closed. Activation starts the first billing period; a store plan bills its first period in full on activation.

## Life of a new plan

| Plan status on record | How it got there | What follows |
|---|---|---|
| Pending verification | The seller opened the plan | It stays here until identity, tax and bank verification completes |
| Active | Identity, tax and bank verification completed; the verification date is recorded and selling starts | The first billing period starts; a store plan's first subscription period is billed in full on activation |
| Closed | The plan was still pending verification once its verification deadline had passed; the application lapses | The plan does not go live |

On activation the plan record shows the date verification completed, the start of the first billing period or term, the end of the annual term (empty on the monthly term and on the Individual Seller Plan) and the next date the subscription fee is billed.

## The verification deadline, both sides of the boundary

The deadline is a number of calendar days counted from the date the plan was opened; the plan's own number of days is the one on its plan schedule. For a hypothetical store plan with a 30-day deadline opened on 1 March:

- the deadline falls on 31 March, 30 calendar days after 1 March;
- on 31 March the deadline has been reached but has not passed, so a plan still pending verification is not yet closed under this standard;
- from 1 April the deadline has passed, and a plan still pending verification on that day is closed.

## Entry requirements as a checklist of conditions

- **Store name.** Required to open any store plan (the Starter, Basic, Premium, Anchor and Enterprise Store); the Individual Seller Plan carries no store name.
- **Minimum trailing 12-month sales.** Applies only where the plan's minimum is above zero; the seller's gross sales over the trailing 12 months must meet that minimum. Where the minimum is zero, no sales requirement applies.
